basic_details.job_title: BFUHS Retired Deputy Controller Finance & Accounts Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Baba Farid University of Health Sciences, Faridkot is holding a walk-in interview on 5 November 2026 for one Retired Deputy Controller Finance & Accounts (DCFA) post. The post is in the UR category and is on tenure basis for one year. It is open to retired DCFAs up to 65 years of age who know Punjabi up to matriculation standard.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid through a bank DD in favour of Registrar, BFUHS, payable at Faridkot, or in online mode.

qualification.details: Age limit: Upto 65 years. Eligibility: Retired DCFA. Language: Knowledge of Punjabi language upto matriculation standard is required. | See the official notification and the University website for the full eligibility terms of this post.

selection_process: Selection is through the walk-in interview. Any selection made on the basis of forged or false documents will be terminated at any time
and legal or departmental proceedings will be intimated.

content_sections.heading: About BFUHS
content_sections.text: Baba Farid University of Health Sciences is a university at Faridkot. This walk-in notice was issued under the signature of its Registrar.

content_sections.heading: BFUHS Retired DCFA Vacancy Details 2026

content_sections.heading: BFUHS Retired DCFA Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: Upto 65 years. Eligibility: Retired DCFA. Language: Knowledge of Punjabi language upto matriculation standard is required. See the official notification and the University website for the full eligibility terms of this post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid through a bank DD in favour of Registrar, BFUHS, payable at Faridkot, or in online mode.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through the walk-in interview. Any selection made on the basis of forged or false documents will be terminated at any time, and legal or departmental proceedings will be intimated.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on tenure basis for one year.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BFUHS Retired DCFA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the application form, category-wise distribution and other terms and conditions from the University website. Pay the fee by bank DD or in online mode. Report on the interview day at the Committee Room with your original certificates and their xerox copies. Bring the following in original and xerox: Proof of date of birth Marks sheet Degree Experience proof Residence proof Category certificate (if applicable) LPC and PPO

faq.question: Q1. Who can attend this BFUHS walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The notice lists the eligibility as Retired DCFA, with age upto 65 years.

faq.question: Q2. What time should candidates report on 5 November 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must report at 9.30 am, although the interview itself is at 12:00 Noon.

faq.question: Q3. How much is the fee for SC candidates?
faq.answer: SC candidates pay Rs. 1180/-, made up of the Rs. 1000 fee and Rs. 180 GST at 18%.

faq.question: Q4. What pay does the post carry?
faq.answer: The notice gives the salary as last pay minus pension, printed as "Last pay (-) Pension", with no fixed amount.

faq.question: Q5. Is Punjabi compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: Yes. The candidate must have knowledge of Punjabi up to matriculation standard.

faq.question: Q6. Which pension-related documents are needed?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their LPC and PPO, in original and xerox, along with their other certificates.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I get the application form?
faq.answer: The notice directs candidates to the University website, www.bfuhs.ac.in, for the form and other terms and conditions.

faq.question: Q8. Who can I call about this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notice prints the University's phone numbers as 01639-256232 and 256236.
